LevelingPlan.RoleHelp: Choose a file for each role. Removing an override restores automatic selection. Shared files affect every assigned job; copy first for different steps. Individual job overrides remain available in Paths. Stop automation and recording before creating, copying or opening a route.
LevelingPlan.RecordingLimits: Automatic detection: movement samples, nearby bosses/chests, targeted event objects and visible dialogs. Detection does not prove successful execution. Dialog choices are placeholders and must be reviewed. Skills/items, jumps, commands, wait conditions, duty mechanics and branches require manual steps. Recording does not guarantee a complete replay.
LevelingPlan.Source: Catalog: game ContentFinderCondition data, including dungeons without installed routes. The built-in stable list is only the default plan, not the full catalog.
LevelingPlan.Login: Log in on a combat job to edit and preview the plan.
LevelingPlan.SelectMode: Select Duty Support or Trust on the main page to preview the corresponding leveling mode.
LevelingPlan.Next: Next duty for current job level
LevelingPlan.NoEligible: No eligible duty: check plan, routes, unlocks, levels and equipment
LevelingPlan.NoLevelSamples: No samples at current job level
LevelingPlan.Timing: Edits apply to the next duty selection; an active run keeps its current route.
LevelingPlan.Rules: Use game entry levels, with no manual level intervals. Switch to the highest-level enabled eligible dungeon as soon as its entry level is reached. Missing routes, locked duties or unmet requirements fall back to a lower eligible dungeon.
LevelingPlan.SharedPlan: Use / Skip settings are shared by all jobs in this configuration. Routes resolve automatically using existing job / role assignments. Manage assignments on the Paths page; changing jobs does not require replanning.
LevelingPlan.MissingNote: Duties without routes remain visible but cannot queue automatically. Record or import routes on Build; manage job assignments on Paths.
